ruleDefinitions.name: DD File Overwrite
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects potential overwriting and deletion of a file using DD.

sequences.query: ((process_path = "\/bin\/dd" OR process_path = "\/usr\/bin\/dd") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*of\\=.*") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*if\\=\\/dev\\/zero.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*if\\=\\/dev\\/null.*")))
